name: Fabric domains
short_description: Domains in Microsoft Fabric group workspaces by business area (for example sales or finance) to define ownership and governance boundaries in a data mesh style setup.

evidence.quote: Domains define responsibility boundaries, sales, finance, operations, HR marketing.
Next fabric introduces domains and subdomains and everyone expects that to fix the sprawl.
Domains bring another layer, domain level roles and domain level policies that can override workspace rules.
